title: Impact of UFPs and MNPs on Fetal Health
official: UPRISE Unravelling Ultrafine Particulate Matter and Micro Nano Plastic's Mechanisms of Impact on Fetal Health
summary: This project aims at unravelling mechanisms by which exposure to air pollution (in particular Ultrafine Particulate (UFP, PM0.1), and micro nano plastic's) interferes with the normal foetus development, with a short-term causal effect in higher likeliness of preterm delivery which, in consequence, precondition a higher likeliness to suffer non-communicable diseases (NCD) later in the life.

sites.f: Instituto de Investigación Sanitaria La Fe
